Card Breaks with Emma Roberts | Fanatics Live

Emma Roberts and her husband Cody John just launched Summer Breaks, their own card break show on Fanatics Live. Your job is to clip their streams into short videos that stop the scroll. Lead with Emma. Most people have no idea she rips cards live, and that surprise is your hook. Find the big pulls.
